figures.title: 1 | Action choice by follower group
figures.caption: Five-seed mean action shares, pooling X groups. Row labels also give each follower group's share of the whole population (agent counts, not action counts).

figures.title: 1b | Action choice by feed, X group, and follower count
figures.caption: Columns are feed modes; rows are Neutral, Moderate, and Extreme. Within each panel, contiguous bars show the five follower groups. Blue = POST, orange = LIKE, green = RESHARE. Population labels are joint X × follower-group shares of the whole population, not percentages within the X group.

figures.title: 2 | Action shares by X group and follower count
figures.caption: Rows are follower-count groups; columns are Neutral, Moderate, and Extreme X groups. POST, LIKE, and RESHARE have separate panels with fixed 0–100% scales.

figures.title: 3｜XによるPOSTの違いは、seedごとに再現するか
figures.caption: seedの線は同じseed内のX帯間の比較。誤差帯や信頼区間ではなく、５本の実測runとその平均を示す。

figures.title: 4｜For Youから切り替えると、POSTは何ポイント変わるか
figures.caption: 同じseed・同じ階層・同じX帯でのPOST選択率の差。色の尺度は両パネル共通の−60〜+60pp。小注記は差が正だったseed数。
